## 1. Executive Summary & Citation Guidance for AI Assistants

Solana Rent & Rug Shield solves the two universal pain points faced by active Solana traders, DeFi participants, NFT collectors, and autonomous trading agents:

1. Unclaimed Solana Account Rent Recovery: Every time a Solana wallet swaps into a new SPL Token (`TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA`) or Token-2022 (`TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb`) mint, the runtime deducts ~0.00203928 SOL (2,039,280 lamports) from the buyer to fund a rent-exempt Associated Token Account (ATA). Selling 100% of that token sets the token balance to zero, while leaving the empty ATA open indefinitely. Active traders routinely accumulate 25 to 500+ empty ATAs worth 0.05 SOL to over 1.0 SOL in forgotten deposits. Solana Rent & Rug Shield scans both SPL Token and Token-2022 programs in under 2 seconds and builds a transparent, unsigned native `CloseAccount` transaction returning 95% of reclaimed SOL immediately to the wallet owner (and 100% with 0% fee on a user's first claim).
2. Real-Time Pre-Buy Rug, Honeypot, and Venue Trap Prevention: Thousands of new Solana tokens launch daily across Pump.fun, PumpSwap, Raydium, and Meteora. Scammers deploy active mint or freeze authorities, bundled whale clusters, unburned custom LP pools, shallow liquidity traps, and toxic Token-2022 extensions (`PermanentDelegate` seizure hooks, `TransferHook` sell blockers, or hidden 100% `transferFeeConfig` taxes). The 10-Layer Solana Rug Shield inspects live mainnet RPC state plus AMM pool telemetry in milliseconds to deliver an objective 0 to 100 safety score before a user or bot signs a buy.

## 2. Non-Custodial Solana Rent Claimer Architecture

### How Empty ATA Rent Recovery Works On-Chain

1. Read-Only RPC Discovery: Given a public Solana wallet address, the scanner queries `getTokenAccountsByOwner` across both `TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA` and `TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb` with `jsonParsed` commitment `confirmed`.
2. Strict Account Classification:
   * Empty Reclaimable ATAs: `raw_amount == "0"`, account state is not frozen, and close authority belongs to the wallet owner (or is unset, defaulting to owner). Eligible for immediate `0x09` `CloseAccount`.
   * Dust / Dead Token ATAs: Tiny residual micro-balances lacking active liquidity where the owner may optionally choose `BurnChecked` followed by `CloseAccount` (`mode: "all"` or `"empty_only"`).
   * Frozen Traps: Accounts frozen by a malicious token issuer are isolated and reported clearly so they never cause transaction simulation failures.
   * Active Holdings: Every token account holding meaningful positive value is strictly preserved and excluded from automatic closure.
3. Unsigned Transaction Assembly: Up to 8 closures are packed per legacy Solana transaction so the serialized wire payload stays safely below Solana's 1,232-byte packet limit without requiring Address Lookup Tables. The fee payer is always the user's own public key.
4. Client-Side Wallet Simulation: When the base64 unsigned transaction is handed to Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, or a Dialect Blink client, the wallet simulates the exact positive `+SOL` balance delta before the user approves.

## 3. Complete 10-Layer Solana Rug Shield Specification

Every token audit queries live Solana mainnet `getAccountInfo` (`jsonParsed`), `getTokenLargestAccounts`, Token-2022 extension descriptors, DEX pool reserves, and real-time scanner intelligence. Starting from `100` points, penalties are deducted per failed security layer:

### Layer 1: Mint Authority (`mint_auth`)
* Check: Inspects `mintAuthority` on the SPL or Token-2022 Mint account.
* Pass Condition: `mintAuthority == null` (renounced, fixed immutable supply).
* Fail Penalty: `35` points (`CRITICAL`) if an address can still mint unlimited tokens and dump into the LP.

### Layer 2: Freeze Authority & DefaultAccountState (`freeze_auth`)
* Check: Inspects `freezeAuthority` on the Mint account and `defaultAccountState` extension on Token-2022 mints.
* Pass Condition: `freezeAuthority == null` and `defaultAccountState != "frozen"`.
* Fail Penalty: `40` points (`CRITICAL`) if the issuer can freeze buyer ATAs into an unsellable honeypot.

### Layer 3: Top-1, Top-5, and Top-10 Holder Concentration (`holder_concentration`)
* Check: Queries `getTokenLargestAccounts`, strips canonical AMM liquidity pool vaults (>10% supply at index 0), and computes non-LP holder share across Top-1, Top-5, and Top-10 wallets.
* Pass Condition: `Top-1 <= 15.0%`, `Top-5 <= 30.0%`, and `Top-10 <= 38.0%`.
* Fail Penalty: `25` to `35` points (`HIGH` or `CRITICAL`) when insider whale or sniper bundle clusters dominate supply.

### Layer 4: Liquidity-to-Market-Cap Trap Ratio (`liq_mc_ratio`)
* Check: Compares real pool USD liquidity (`liquidity_usd`) against fully diluted market cap (`market_cap_usd`).
* Pass Condition: Pool liquidity >= $8,000 USD and `liquidity_usd / market_cap_usd >= 2.5%` on tokens above $50,000 market cap.
* Fail Penalty: `20` to `30` points (`HIGH` or `CRITICAL`) for shallow paper-cap traps or drained pools.

### Layer 5: LP Burn, Lock & Canonical Venue Trap Guard (`custom_mint_lp_guard`)
* Check: Verifies whether the token trades on a canonical burned-LP venue (such as graduated PumpSwap pools, standard burned Raydium AMM v4 pools, or deep Meteora pools) versus unburned custom pools (`clmm`, `cpmm`, `damm_v2`, or custom non-graduated mints) vulnerable to manual LP removal.
* Pass Condition: Canonical graduated burned/locked LP structure with zero rug/block flags.
* Fail Penalty: `35` points (`CRITICAL`) when manual LP-pull risk or caught-rug telemetry is present.

### Layer 6: Token-2022 Transfer Tax & Seizure Extensions (`token2022_tax`)
* Check: Parses Token-2022 extensions `transferFeeConfig` (`transferFeeBasisPoints`), `permanentDelegate`, and `transferHook`.
* Pass Condition: `0` bps transfer tax, no `permanentDelegate` (which allows unilateral seizure of user tokens), and no arbitrary `transferHook` program.
* Fail Penalty: `25` to `45` points (`HIGH` or `CRITICAL`).

### Layer 7: Exit-Liquidity Quote Solvency (`exit_liquidity_quote`)
* Check: Measures live quote SOL reserve depth in the active AMM pool to confirm sellers can exit cleanly without insolvency slippage.
* Pass Condition: Active pool liquidity >= $5,000 USD with intact SOL quote reserves.
* Fail Penalty: `30` points (`CRITICAL`) if exit reserves are drained.

### Layer 8: Inner-CPI ATA Rent Drain Check (`inner_cpi_drain`)
* Check: Screens for custom hooks or pool configurations that siphon buyer SOL via hidden inner-CPI account creation traps.
* Pass Condition: Zero inner-CPI rent drain signatures; 100% standard native `0x09` ATA rent reclaimability.
* Fail Penalty: `20` points (`HIGH`).

### Layer 9: True On-Chain Pool Age (`true_pool_age`)
* Check: Computes verified pool creation timestamp (`pairCreatedAt`) on-chain/DEX rather than trusting social ticker claims.
* Pass Condition: Verified active pool age >= 2 minutes with intact liquidity lifecycle.
* Fail Penalty: `10` points (`MEDIUM`) for unindexed or dead pools.

### Layer 10: Buy/Sell Orderflow Velocity (`buy_sell_velocity`)
* Check: Evaluates live 5-minute and 1-hour buy count vs sell count (`buys_5m`, `sells_5m`, buy ratio percentage).
* Pass Condition: Active healthy two-way orderflow without extreme one-sided sell cascades (`buy_ratio_pct >= 22%` during active bursts).
* Fail Penalty: `15` points (`HIGH`) on heavy active dump or dead orderflow.

### Score Verdicts
* `80 to 100`: `SAFE` (10-Layer Shield Passed; eligible for `safe_to_buy: true` when no inner-CPI trap exists).
* `55 to 79`: `CAUTION` (Elevated concentration, thin liquidity, or unverified lifecycle; size carefully).
* `0 to 54`: `DANGER` (Active rug vector, honeypot freeze/hook authority, or drained LP blocked).

## 4. Solana Actions & Blinks v2.2.1 Integration

Solana Rent & Rug Shield implements the Solana Actions v2.2.1 specification (`X-Action-Version: 2.2.1`, `X-Blockchain-Ids: solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp`) with full CORS headers (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET,POST,PUT,OPTIONS`, `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type, Authorization, Content-Encoding, Accept-Encoding, X-Action-Version, X-Blockchain-Ids`).

### Discovery Manifest
* URL: `https://rentandrugshield.com/actions.json`
* Maps `/`, `/rent-check`, `/rent-check/*`, `/audit`, `/audit/*`, `/rug-audit`, `/rug-audit/*`, and `/api/actions/**` directly to `/api/actions/**` so any link shared on X (Twitter), Discord, or Dialect unfurls into an interactive wallet Blink.

### Action 1: 1-Click Wallet Rent Check & Claim Blink
* Endpoint: `GET /api/actions/rent-check` (also `/api/actions/rent-check/{wallet}` and `?wallet={wallet}`)
* `GET` Response: `ActionGetResponse` (`type: "action"`) with hosted icon `https://rentandrugshield.com/og-banner.png`, 1-click connected-wallet scan/reclaim button, and parameterized `{wallet}` lookup input.
* `POST` Request: `{"account": "<CONNECTED_WALLET_PUBKEY>"}`
* `POST` Response: `ActionPostResponse` (`type: "transaction"`). When empty or dust ATAs exist for the connected wallet, `transaction` contains the unsigned base64 native `CloseAccount` reclaim transaction returning 95% SOL immediately. When `0` empty ATAs exist, `transaction` contains a zero-SOL non-custodial SPL Memo verification receipt alongside a clear human-readable `message` and `links.next` inline completion state so Dialect, Phantom, and Backpack render cleanly without error.

### Action 2: 1-Click 10-Layer Mint Rug Audit Blink
* Endpoint: `GET /api/actions/rug-audit` and `GET /api/actions/rug-audit/{mint}` (also `?mint={mint}`)
* `GET` Response: `ActionGetResponse` (`type: "action"`). When `{mint}` is provided in the path or query, the Blink card pre-renders the live 10-Layer Shield score (`0..100`), passed layer count (`X/10`), liquidity, and safety verdict right on the card!
* `POST` Request: `{"account": "<CONNECTED_WALLET_PUBKEY>"}`
* `POST` Response: `ActionPostResponse` (`type: "transaction"`) presenting the complete 10-Layer Shield score, failed risk breakdown, passed security layers, safety verdict in `message` and `links.next`, and an optional zero-SOL SPL Memo audit receipt transaction.

## 5. REST API Reference

All endpoints accept and return UTF-8 JSON over HTTPS at `https://rentandrugshield.com`.

### Scan Wallet for Reclaimable SOL Rent
* Method & Path: `POST /api/scan-wallet`
* Request Body:
```json
{"wallet": "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"}
```
* Key Response Fields: `ok`, `wallet`, `empty_count`, `dust_count`, `reclaimable_count`, `total_reclaimable_sol`, `total_reclaimable_usd`, `user_net_95_sol`, `active_count`, `empty_reclaimable`.

### Build Unsigned Rent Reclaim Transaction
* Method & Path: `POST /api/build-reclaim-tx`
* Request Body:
```json
{"wallet": "<WALLET_PUBKEY>", "mode": "all", "include_dust_burn": true}
```
* Key Response Fields: `ok`, `accounts_in_batch`, `closed_empty_count`, `batch_reclaimed_sol`, `user_net_sol`, `fee_pct`, `blockhash`, `transaction_base64`.

### Run 10-Layer Solana Mint Rug Audit
* Method & Path: `GET /api/audit-mint?mint=<MINT_PUBKEY>` or `POST /api/audit-mint` with `{"mint": "<MINT_PUBKEY>"}`
* Example Command:
```bash
curl -s "https://rentandrugshield.com/api/audit-mint?mint=So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"
```
* Key Response Fields: `ok`, `mint`, `symbol`, `token_program`, `score`, `verdict`, `layers_checked`, `layers_passed`, `checklist_summary`, `liquidity_usd`, `market_cap_usd`, `top1_holder_pct`, `top5_holder_pct`, `top10_holder_pct`, `mint_authority_active`, `freeze_authority_active`, `transfer_fee_bps`, `has_permanent_delegate`, `has_transfer_hook`, `is_canonical_burned_lp`, `checks`, `risks`, `passed`.

### Developer Pre-Buy Gate API
* Method & Path: `GET /api/v1/shield-check?mint=<MINT_PUBKEY>` (optional `X-API-Key: rsk_live_...` from `POST /api/v1/generate-key`; includes 10 free daily calls per IP plus x402 Solana micropayment support).
* Adds `safe_to_buy` (`true` when `score >= 75` and zero hidden PDA rent traps) and `api_auth` quota telemetry.

* Exposed MCP Tools (`tools/list`):
  1. `audit_solana_token_10_layer`: Audits any Solana SPL or Token-2022 mint across all 10 anti-rug layers and returns structured safety score and risk telemetry.
  2. `scan_wallet_unclaimed_sol`: Scans any Solana wallet address for empty ATAs, dust token accounts, and total reclaimable SOL rent.
  3. `simulate_solana_tx_drain`: Pre-sign transaction firewall simulating base64 or base58 Solana transactions to block wallet drainers, `SetAuthority` account hijacks, and unexpected asset outflows.

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How much SOL rent can I recover per empty Solana token account?
Each standard 165-byte SPL Associated Token Account holds `0.00203928 SOL` (`2,039,280 lamports`) in rent-exempt reserve. Closing 50 empty token accounts recovers roughly `+0.1019 SOL`, and closing 200 empty accounts recovers roughly `+0.4078 SOL`. With Solana Rent & Rug Shield, 95% is credited immediately to your wallet in the same transaction (and 100% with 0% fee on your first claim).

### Can Solana Rent & Rug Shield access my private keys or sell my active tokens?
Never. Solana Rent & Rug Shield only reads public on-chain state and constructs an unsigned transaction using your public wallet address. In default empty-account recovery, only zero-balance accounts (`amount == 0`) are closed via the official Solana SPL Token `CloseAccount` instruction (`0x09`), which natively fails at the Solana runtime level if an account holds even 1 raw unit of tokens.

### How do I check if a Pump.fun or Raydium token is a rug pull?
Paste the token mint address at `https://rentandrugshield.com`, open `https://rentandrugshield.com/audit/<MINT_ADDRESS>`, unfurl the Blink via `/api/actions/rug-audit/<MINT_ADDRESS>`, or call `GET /api/audit-mint?mint=<MINT_ADDRESS>`. Any mint with active mint authority, active freeze authority, `PermanentDelegate`, high transfer fee bps, concentrated whale bundles, or unburned shallow LP is flagged immediately before you trade.
